beats.title: Exploring Wolf Manor: conservatory, bedroom loot, and library clues
beats.summary: Inside Wolf Manor, Caelynn searches for the conservatory, climbing through rooms and stairs to reach the glass chamber. The telescope yields nothing useful at noon. Meanwhile Bonogo raids the master bedroom, finding a lockbox with a diary, old papers, a ring with the Wolf sigil, and family notes. The group then searches the library, discovers a hidden door and servants' stairs to the attic, and opens a storage room leading into the kitchen while Ephanna leaves an Unseen Servant to clean up.

beats.summary: Back at the festival, Stafl gives Bardic Inspiration before the Mage's Duel begins. The recap lays out the three-round structure of the event. beats.title: Combat trials in the storm colosseum: tavern brawl victory
beats.summary: The team of Bonogo, Baergrom, and Ogonob enters the Colosseum of the Storm for a magically transformed tavern brawl against Hagan, a Human Barbarian Druid. Early momentum shifts as Hagan charges Bonogo, but the team responds with darts, punches, improvised weapons, and coordinated damage. Hagan briefly transforms into a bear, but the party breaks through the bear form and finishes the fight by knocking him prone and landing the final devastating blows.
